mapper.select: SELECT id,order_no,buyer_id,vendor_id,status FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_notifications WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND kind=#{kind} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND created_at > NOW(3) - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.buyer_id FROM t_orders o WHERE o.status='shipped' AND o.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND GREATEST(o.shipped_at,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(l.created_at) FROM t_order_logistics l WHERE l.order_id=o.id),o.shipped_at)) < NOW(3) - INTERVAL 48 HOUR

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_orders o WHERE o.id=#{orderId} AND o.status='shipped' AND o.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND GREATEST(o.shipped_at,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(l.created_at) FROM t_order_logistics l WHERE l.order_id=o.id),o.shipped_at)) < NOW(3) - INTERVAL 48 HOUR
